# N6: Review notes, print-motion

A check of the core ([the journeys](../journeys.md)): not a journey with steps a person takes, but a script that opens pages and reports what is wrong (Faro’s `evals/notes/6-print-motion.cjs`). A rebuild proves the same by hand or with its own script: every failure below must not happen. Each is in the script’s words; {…} is what it measured, and a limit its words don’t give is added after it, in the script’s test (“its test: …”).

## What it checks

Lane's review notes (5 Nov), print-motion. [Print] a goal and a review session each print as A4 portrait pages with everything critical, no navigation, black on white, status as shape plus word. [Motion] everything moves for 250ms at most and not at all under reduced motion; counts land on their value; rows slide to their new places and end there.

## Where it looks

- 390 × 844, as amara, at `/goals/ns-lead/print`
- 768 × 1024, as amara, at `/goals/ns-lead/print`
- 1280 × 800, as amara, at `/goals/ns-lead/print`
- 390 × 844, as amara, at `/reviews/weekly/print`
- 1024 × 768, as amara, at `/reviews/weekly/print`
- 1280 × 800, as amara, at `/goals/ns-lead`
- 1280 × 800, as amara, at `/reviews/weekly`

A width of 390 is a phone, 1440 (or 1280) a desktop; the address is in the demo on Thursday 5 November 2026 unless it names another day. {…} is a value the script works out as it runs.
